changelog: A controller that answers Modbus from address 01 or 60 is accepted at last: its replies were thrown away, so the gateway reported that nothing had answered
Any valid reply now settles the address search, and a refused live read is retried with a shorter register block
Live replies are routed by length, so a longer live frame is no longer lost without a word
The gateway no longer holds its whole loop between controller frames, so the cloud link and the setup page stay responsive
